title: "Families and the eight steps"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

[Step families](../families/numeric-features.qmd) and the
[eight positions](../basics/four-stages-eight-steps.qmd) are two groupings of
the same steps: a family says what kind of column a step works on, a position
says when it runs. Crossing them shows where each step lives, and that the
two cut across each other rather than nesting.

*Italicized* steps are planned or not yet in this build; see the family pages
for the tracking issues.

| Position | Numeric | Categorical | Datetime | Missing data | Text | Dim. reduction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [1. Missing: impute](../four-stages/missing-impute.qmd) | | | | `step_impute_mean` `step_impute_median` `step_impute_mode` | | |
| [2. Missing: category levels](../four-stages/missing-category-levels.qmd) | | `step_unknown` *`step_other`* *`step_novel`* | | `step_unknown` | | |
| [3. Wrangle: transforms](../four-stages/wrangle-transforms.qmd) | *`step_log`* *`step_order_norm`* | | *`step_date_features`* *`step_datetime_features`* | | | |
| [4. Wrangle: discretize](../four-stages/wrangle-discretize.qmd) | none | | | | | |
| [5. Wrangle: dummy variables](../four-stages/wrangle-dummy-variables.qmd) | | `step_dummy` `step_one_hot` | *`step_holiday`* | | | |
| [6. Model prep: interactions](../four-stages/model-prep-interactions.qmd) | `step_polynomial` *`step_interact`* | | | | | |
| [7. Model prep: normalize](../four-stages/model-prep-normalize.qmd) | `step_normalize` *`step_range`* | | | | | |
| [8. Multivariate transforms](../four-stages/multivariate-transforms.qmd) | | | | | | `step_pca` `step_class_distance` *`step_pls`* |

Reading the empty space is as useful as reading the cells:

- **[Text features](../families/text-features.qmd) has no entries at all**: that family
  is handled at the recipe's boundary today, not by steps.
- **Position 4 (discretize) is empty by design**: no step fills it, and R
  recipes itself discourages it.
- **The filter steps don't appear**: `step_drop_zero_variance` and
  `step_drop_corr` hold no position; see
  [dropping columns](../basics/dropping-columns.qmd).
